findings.title: Hardcoded fallback JWT / session secret
findings.snippet: SECRET_KEY = os.environ.get("SECRET_KEY") or "dev-secret"  # F-4: hardcoded fallback secret
findings.remediation: Fail closed on startup if the signing secret env var is unset; never fall back to a hardcoded default.

findings.title: Weak hash (MD5/SHA-1) used for passwords
findings.remediation: Store passwords with Argon2id, scrypt or bcrypt (or PBKDF2 with a high work factor), never fast hashes.

findings.title: SQL built with string interpolation / raw unsafe query
findings.snippet: f"SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = '{email}' AND password_hash = '{password_hash}'"  # F-1: SQL injection
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements ($1, ?, :param) or tagged-template Prisma.$queryRaw.

findings.title: Server-side template built from a dynamic string (SSTI)
findings.snippet:
return render_template_string("

Hello " + name + "

") # F-3: server-side template injection
findings.remediation: Render fixed template files and pass user data only as context variables; never compile user-controlled templates.

findings.title: Container runs as root (no non-root USER in final stage)
findings.remediation: Create an unprivileged user and switch to it with USER in the final stage (distroless :nonroot images also work).

findings.title: Open redirect to a request-controlled URL
findings.remediation: Redirect only to relative paths or an allowlist of hosts; reject absolute and protocol-relative (//) URLs.

findings.title: Non-cryptographic RNG used for a security token
findings.snippet: reset_token = str(random.randint(100000, 999999))  # F-7: predictable reset token
findings.remediation: Use a CSPRNG: crypto.randomBytes / crypto.randomUUID, Python secrets, random_bytes(), SecureRandom.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled in code/config
findings.snippet: app.run(host="0.0.0.0", debug=True)  # F-8: debug mode (Werkzeug console = RCE)
findings.remediation: Ensure DEBUG=False / APP_DEBUG=false in production and load it from environment config.

findings.title: Container base image uses :latest or no tag
findings.remediation: Pin base images to a specific version tag, ideally by digest (image@sha256:...).
